chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding the mention of measures and weights.
About the passing away and perishing of this world, and the condition of its people within it.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the nature of this world in his sermon on measures and weights?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) uses the precision of commercial scales as a metaphor for divine justice, warning that just as weights must be exact in trade, so too must deeds be weighed on the Day of Judgment. This passage underscores the Shia emphasis on *Adl* (justice) and the spiritual gravity of honesty in daily transactions, linking mundane economic acts to eternal accountability.
